schemaVersionService.storedVersionNewer: Stored schema version ({stored}) for "{schemaName}" is newer than the current version ({current}). Downgrade is not supported.
schemaVersionService.noMigrationStep: No migration step from version {missingFromVersion} to {missingToVersion} found for "{schemaName}". Cannot complete migration from {stored} to {current}. Register the versioned schema class "{schemaName}V{missingFromVersion}" in EntitySchemaFactory.
schemaVersionService.noMigrationStepTarget: No target schema for migration step {missingFromVersion} to {missingToVersion} found for "{schemaName}". Cannot complete migration from {stored} to {current}. Register the versioned schema class "{schemaName}V{missingToVersion}" in EntitySchemaFactory.
schemaVersionService.connectorNotMigrationCapable: Schema "{schemaName}" needs migration from version {stored} to {current} but its connector does not support automatic migration. Please migrate the schema manually before starting the node.

schemaVersionService.migrationDisabled: Schema migration is disabled. Schema "{schemaName}" requires migration from version {from} to {to}. Continuing without migration may cause errors.

schemaVersionService.noMigrationRequired: No migration required for schema "{schemaName}", version {version}.
schemaVersionService.migrationRequired: Migration required for schema "{schemaName}" from version {from} to {to}.
schemaVersionService.connectorVersionUpdated: Connector version changed from {from} to {to}; forcing schema migrations.
schemaVersionService.connectorVersionForceUpgrade: Forcing migration for schema "{schemaName}" because connector version changed.
schemaVersionService.partitionItemsStart: Starting migration of {itemTotal} items in current partition.
schemaVersionService.partitionItemsProgress: Migrating items in current partition: {itemIndex} of {itemTotal} processed.
schemaVersionService.partitionItemsEnd: Completed migration of {itemTotal} items in current partition.
